QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults to off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`)... which also needs `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD`, default off at `mbedtls_config.h:2196`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both threading macros are off by default in the shipped mbedtls_config.h, so a default build defines neither.
